concerns.text: The plan evaluates UQ methods on three materials properties but substitutes Formation Energy for Elastic Modulus (a mechanical property). This proxy changes the scientific question from assessing UQ across truly diverse property classes (electronic, thermal, mechanical) to only electronic/thermal/thermodynamic properties, limiting the validity of any claim about mechanical‑property uncertainty quantification.

The plan states it will compute Expected Calibration Error (ECE) for regression interval predictions. ECE is defined for classification confidence scores; applying the standard binning‑based ECE to regression prediction intervals is not a standard calibration metric in the materials‑science regression literature and may yield misleading calibration assessments.
